stories.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion, valuation hits $6.2 billion
stories.summary: Tenstorrent, a ten‑year‑old AI inference chip startup, closed a $1.5 billion financing round that values the company at $6.2 billion, more than double its late‑2024 valuation of $2.6 billion. The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Fidelity, SanDisk and T. Rowe Price. CEO Jim Keller said the money will be used to scale chips for open‑weight AI models and video‑generation workloads.
stories.why: The funding gives Tenstorrent resources to expand its hardware offering in a market dominated by Nvidia, potentially increasing competition for AI developers.

stories.title: RBI launches Rs 1 lakh crore variable‑rate repo auction
stories.summary: On Monday the Reserve Bank of India announced a Rs 1 lakh crore variable‑rate repo (VRR) auction, the first such operation since late July, after the weighted‑average call rate rose to 5.67%, 17 basis points above the 5.50% repo rate. The central bank will conduct a second VRR of Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: RBI tightens scrutiny of $1 billion‑plus overseas investments by Indian firms
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is implementing stricter scrutiny of large overseas direct investments by Indian companies. Banks must now collect and submit detailed information on each such investment, including a due‑diligence checklist on the investment rationale. The initiative aims to prevent potential losses for the companies and the Indian economy.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.previousSummary: The Reserve Bank of India has introduced stricter review of overseas direct investments exceeding $1 billion by Indian companies.
